facts.Page story text 1 (draft, teacher check: Tom and Huck went to find treasure. They went into a dark cave. It was scary but exciting. Adventure needs courage.
facts.Page story text 2 (draft, teacher check: Tom and his friend Huck decided to search for hidden treasure. They heard Injun Joe had buried gold coins somewhere nearby. Tom led the way into a deep, dark cave with just a candle. Adventure needs courage, and Tom had plenty of it inside him. Huck was shaking but followed his brave friend into the dark. Together they faced their fears and walked deeper underground.
facts.Word cards: cave = 동굴 / courage = 용기 / dark = 어두운 / give up = 포기하다
